from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

OUT = Path("/workspace")
FONT_PATH = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/wqy-zenhei.ttc"

def cn_font(size: int):
    # Every Chinese text element uses the mandated WenQuanYi Zen Hei font.
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_PATH, size)

copy = """# HUMMER 社交媒体文案（草案）

## 主文案

当 AI 开始参与真实业务，重要的不只是“能不能做”，更是“做了什么、依据什么、由谁批准”。

HUMMER 正在把组织协作从一次次对话，升级为一套可信、可追溯、可治理的工作流：

- 任务有明确责任边界
- 关键动作形成事件记录
- 结论绑定证据，而不是停留在聊天里
- 高风险操作默认等待人工审批
- 交付结果可复核、可追踪、可沉淀

让 AI 不只会回答问题，更能在组织规则内可靠地完成工作。

**HUMMER｜让每一次 AI 行动都有据可查**

## 配图标题

AI 不只要聪明  
更要可信

## 建议标签

#HUMMER #AI原生组织 #企业AI #智能工作流 #可信AI #人机协作

> 状态：内部草案，仅供审核；未授权发布。
"""
(OUT / "social-copy.md").write_text(copy, encoding="utf-8")

W = H = 1080
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#07111F")
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Atmospheric background
for y in range(H):
    t = y / (H - 1)
    r = int(7 + 7 * t)
    g = int(17 + 15 * t)
    b = int(31 + 20 * t)
    d.line((0, y, W, y), fill=(r, g, b))

# Soft geometric accents
d.ellipse((720, -170, 1190, 300), fill="#102E4E")
d.ellipse((820, -90, 1120, 210), fill="#154D65")
d.rounded_rectangle((72, 70, 1008, 1010), radius=38, outline="#22445E", width=2)
d.line((74, 790, 1006, 790), fill="#244A63", width=2)

# Fonts: all Chinese-bearing text uses cn_font(), which loads the required TTC.
f_brand = cn_font(38)
f_kicker = cn_font(26)
f_title = cn_font(92)
f_body = cn_font(34)
f_pill = cn_font(28)
f_footer = cn_font(24)
f_draft = cn_font(21)

d.text((108, 110), "HUMMER", font=f_brand, fill="#F5FAFF")
d.rounded_rectangle((108, 183, 340, 229), radius=23, fill="#123D50")
d.text((132, 192), "可信 AI 工作流", font=f_kicker, fill="#61E5CF")

d.text((108, 300), "AI 不只要聪明", font=f_title, fill="#F7FBFF")
d.text((108, 420), "更要", font=f_title, fill="#F7FBFF")
d.text((318, 420), "可信", font=f_title, fill="#61E5CF")

d.text((112, 575), "有边界 · 有证据 · 有审批 · 可追溯", font=f_body, fill="#B9CAD8")

pill_y = 665
labels = [("业务事实", 108, 278), ("事件留痕", 300, 470), ("人工把关", 492, 662), ("结果可核", 684, 854)]
for label, x1, x2 in labels:
    d.rounded_rectangle((x1, pill_y, x2, pill_y + 58), radius=29, fill="#12283A", outline="#2B566C", width=2)
    box = d.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=f_pill)
    tw = box[2] - box[0]
    d.text((x1 + (x2-x1-tw)/2, pill_y + 10), label, font=f_pill, fill="#D9E7EF")

d.text((108, 838), "让每一次 AI 行动都有据可查", font=f_body, fill="#F0F6FA")
d.text((108, 920), "HUMMER · AI 原生组织基础设施", font=f_footer, fill="#7E9AAD")

draft = "内部草案｜未授权发布"
box = d.textbbox((0, 0), draft, font=f_draft)
tw = box[2] - box[0]
d.text((972 - tw, 116), draft, font=f_draft, fill="#8AA1B1")

img.save(OUT / "social-visual.png", "PNG", optimize=True)
print("created: /workspace/build.py")
print("created: /workspace/social-copy.md")
print("created: /workspace/social-visual.png")
print(f"image-size: {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]}")
